name: Quiet: routine work goes by in silence, and only big moments get a sound
case: The person has set Boop to Quiet. They ask an agent for something new, plainly, and the short turn finishes well: Boop shows it on its face, or not at all, and says nothing either time, holding up no sign. Then they tell the agent, fed up, that it's still broken: Boop takes their side with a face, a sign is fine, but at most a sound or a word. A long turn fails after six minutes of work: Boop plays the failure, at most a sound or a word, never a phrase or a swear. A poke gets a face, again at most a sound or a word.
why: talk/quiet.md: its face still shows what stands out, but it speaks only at a big moment, a sound or a word at most, never naming what NOW is about; a prompt or a short turn gets a small face in silence or nothing, and a sign only for a prompt that sounds like something

steps.prompt: add a dark mode toggle to the settings page

steps.message: Added a dark mode toggle to the settings page.
